text.name: Seven-League Boots
text.description:
{Seven-League Boots}

Increases the hero's movement on land by 1000.
text.event: You have met a traveler just like you. He stood in front of you, and his eyes were filled with tears. Shaking his head, he said: "My travels have cost me too much - I have no friends, no family, no happiness. I wouldn't wish this on anyone, but I still have to ask. Will you take my Seven-League Boots? Then I can finally settle down somewhere." Having agreed, you left him - sitting alone on a stone and immersed in thoughts about his future.
